openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The Nexx WT3020 is a series of miniature routers based on the MediaTek MT7620n with two Ethernet ports and a 802.11n 2T/2R 2.4 GHz 300Mbps wireless interface. There are several models with different hardware and software features.

varianten_tabelle.Description: Wireless router with USB port and 3G dongle support¹
Wireless router with USB port and 3G dongle support¹
Wireless router with USB port, 3G dongle support and extra features¹²

openwrt_wiki.varianten_fussnoten: ¹: differences between WT3020H, WT3020F and WT3020AD are only found in the original firmware; ²: extra features are unknown; ³: different hardware model, see below

hardware_info.Flash chip: Winbond W25Q32BV (4MB), W25Q64BV or cFeon Q64-104HIP or 25Q64FVSIG (8MB) ¹

openwrt_wiki.serial: The serial port of the WT3020 can be accessed using the TTL pins shown in the image below. A voltage level converter (such as a CP2102 TTL-USB dongle) is required. The communication settings are: 57600 bps 8N1. (Foto media:nexx:wt3020:wt3020a_serial_ttl.jpg: zwei runde Loetpunkte Tx/Rx zwischen SoC und Ethernet-Buchsen, WT3020A-Platine "WT3020-V1.0 2013-11-20")
openwrt_wiki.identifying: On the WT3020H model (8 MB flash), the Ethernet MAC starts with 20:28:18:...
openwrt_wiki.gpio: GPIOs 0, 2, 18, and 19 are exposed on the board ... connected to pull-down resistors (Fotos WT3020H)
known_problems: certain versions of uboot are reported as problematic - POSSIBLE BRICK (dev.openwrt.org/ticket/19570)
factory firmware to do the initial upgrade is reported non-working, fails with "Bad Magic Number", sysupgrade via mtd works (dev.openwrt.org/ticket/19983)
failsafe mode is reported non-working (dev.openwrt.org/ticket/18768); The same issue again exists with the WT3020F "new" hardware model on CC.15.05rc3
openwrt_wiki.installation: factory.bin ueber die Stock-Weboberflaeche: http://192.168.8.1, System Setting -> Upgrade Firmware; danach LuCI auf 192.168.1.1. Daneben Abschnitt zum Tausch des Bootloaders (Breed) - hier nicht uebernommen.
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: mtd0 u-boot 0x30000, mtd1 u-boot-env 0x10000, mtd2 factory 0x10000, mtd3 firmware 0x7b0000 (8M)
openwrt_wiki.factory_partition: MAC-Adresse in mtd2 ab Offset 4; eth0.2 (WAN) = LAN-MAC + 1
openwrt_wiki.netzwerk: WAN-Port (towards the edge of the PCB) ist eth0.2 / Switch-Port 0; LAN eth0.1; CPU-Port 6
openwrt_wiki.failsafe: Failsafe mode appears to be broken as of r43977; Update 03 jan 2018: Failsafe mode appears again to be broken, with the new hardware model.
openwrt_wiki.bootlog_openwrt: U-Boot 1.1.3 (Jan 3 2014), spi device id 1c 30 17 -> find flash: EN25Q64, DRAM component: 512 Mbits DDR, width 16, Total memory 64 MBytes, CPU freq 580 MHz, SoC Type Ralink MT7620N ver:2 eco:6, Kernel console=ttyS0,57600 (Hostname WT3020H)
openwrt_wiki.bootlog_original: U-Boot 1.1.3 (Jan 7 2013), Ralink UBoot Version 4.1.0.0, find flash: W25Q32BV (4-MB-Geraet), Linux 2.6.36
openwrt_wiki.poe_mod: Eigenbau: unbenutzte Adernpaare 4/5 (+) und 7/8 (GND) eines Ports abtrennen, DC-DC-Wandler 5-17 V -> 5 V, Umschalter gegen Rueckspeisung; "NEXX ITSELF HAS 1.2 ADC"; 5 V von Micro-USB und USB-A sind verbunden
openwrt_wiki.flash_vergroessern: Austausch des SO8-Flash gegen 16/32 MB moeglich (eigene DTS noetig)

openwrt_wiki.Failsafe: Update 03 jan 2018: Failsafe mode appears again to be broken, with the new hardware model. More details will follow.

openwrt_wiki.Flash layout: mtd0 u-boot 0x30000, mtd1 u-boot-env 0x10000, mtd2 factory 0x10000, mtd3 firmware 0x7b0000
openwrt_wiki.Factory: MAC-Adresse in mtd2 (factory) Offset 4; eth0.2 (WAN) = LAN-MAC + 1
openwrt_wiki.Netzwerk: WAN-Port (towards the edge of the PCB) ist eth0.2; Switch-Port 0 = WAN, LAN auf VLAN 1
openwrt_wiki.Bootlog (WT3020H): U-Boot 1.1.3 (Jan 3 2014), Ralink UBoot Version 4.1.1.0, ASIC 7620_MP, DRAM 512 Mbits DDR width 16, 64 MB, flash EN25Q64 (8 MB), CPU 580 MHz, console=ttyS0,57600, SoC Ralink MT7620N ver:2 eco:6
openwrt_wiki.PoE mod: Bastelanleitung: PoE über freie Adernpaare 4/5 und 7/8 (nur 100 Mbit), Step-down 5-17 V auf 5 V, Umschalter gegen Rückstrom. Zitat: "it does not have a PoE capability", "NEXX ITSELF HAS 1.2 ADC". "The 5 VDC are short-circuited on both microUSB and USB-A ports"
openwrt_wiki.Flash-Vergrößerung: Anleitung zum Tausch des SO8-SPI-Flash gegen 16/32 MB (MX25L128/MX25L256), danach eigener Build nötig; U-Boot-TFTP Option 2, Server 192.168.0.233, Datei root_uImage

lauf.notiz: Zusammenführung der Alias-Einträge nexx-wt3020h/-f/-ad (alle 2026-10-20, Quellen dort abgerufen: ToH-Dump und Live-hwdata je Variante, OpenWrt-Wiki der Serie, Commits/DTS/mt7620.mk, Gluon-Target, DeviWiki/WikiDevi, FCC N28WT3020H mit Handbuch, Etikett, Innen-/Außenfotos, RF-Testbericht, RF-Exposure, Herstellerseite im Webarchiv) plus 11 eigene Anfragen: Gluon-Tags v2018.2/v2018.2.1 (Support ab v2018.2.1, "ab v2019.1" aus nexx-wt3020f widerlegt), Platinenunterseiten WT3020H (2015) und WT3020F new hardware model (2018) - gleich bestückt, RAM EtronTech EM6AB160TSE-5G; altes OpenWrt-Forum 54717 im Webarchiv (Flash EN25Q64, Konsole per angelöteten Drähten); FCC Test-Setup-Photos = RF-Testbericht; 4 Herstellerdetailbilder (Werbung, keine Spezifikation). Kein Werkstatt-Protokoll. Innen, Micro-USB 5 V (ToH 0.5 A, Typenschild 1.2 A), kein Netzteil im Lieferumfang, 2x 10/100, 1x USB-A, 2x2 b/g/n intern, Seriell innen Lötpunkte 57600 8N1. Offen: GND/Pinbelegung an H/F/AD, Oberseite des WT3020F new hardware model, Montage, Gewicht, Leistungsaufnahme, Geizhals/EAN/ASIN.
